title: Data value determining method and device in federal learning

pse.problem: Accurate evaluation of each participant's data contribution in a federal learning scenario is challenging.
pse.solution_function: The system performs federation learning results prediction for a given data set, extracts features with random substitution, trains a data value evaluation model based on factorizer, and predicts the data value of the federal learning object using feature weights and hidden vector matrixes.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises components for obtaining data sets, determining feature sets, performing feature extraction, federation learning, sample labeling, training data value evaluation model, and predicting data values.
pse.solution_implementation: The system follows a process of multiple iterations of feature extraction with random substitution, federation learning based on the resulting feature sets, labeling samples according to federation learning results, training data value evaluation model using these samples and labels, and predicting data values using the trained model.
pse.effect: The proposed method enables accurate evaluation of each participant's data contribution in a federal learning scenario, improving the fairness of data transaction pricing.
